maintenance_led.reason: Water Quality (Hach, Trojan, Ott) and Product Quality (Videojet, Linx) mostly sell new instruments and printers, plus consumables and service.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mostly private industrial, food, beverage and consumer goods manufacturers, plus some municipal utilities; government is not the majority payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth is mainly organic through product innovation and sales; it makes occasional bolt-on deals like Cleanwater1 and a UV business.

mission_critical.reason: Water testing, disinfection and product coding/traceability systems sit in regulated operations and production lines; switching needs requalification and risks downtime.
